$comment: Project files this plugin supplies, for `kit doctor` and `/kit-adopt`. Every skill in skills/ also counts as kit-owned.

The kit's svelte-runes skill holds the generic rules; keep only project paths and project checks (folders for helpers and stores, complexity gates) in a file with another name.
partial..claude/rules/accessibility-rules.md: The kit's svelte-a11y skill holds the generic rules; keep only references to the project's own components, utilities and recipes in a file with another name.
partial..claude/rules/tailwind-css-v3-rules.md: The kit's tailwind-styling skill holds the generic rules; keep only the project's token names in a file with another name.
partial..claude/rules/ui-styling.md: Only the Tailwind conventions come from the kit (tailwind-styling skill); the project's design language (tokens, control sizes, corners, scrollbars, shared components) stays in the project.
